answer: Sponsored admission: a newcomer enters only when a sponsor locks 200 credits and offers it harbor. It starts at a low anchor: verified jobs raise it, idle reputation decays 5% per epoch, only a crystal record of work lifts it. Proven fraud halves the sponsor bond, so rented sponsors lose money. 1,000 fake identities need 1,000 sponsors and 200,000 credits locked against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays one bond once, keeps its full share.
